_doc: Currency shards (ruling 9): each does ONE thing, PoE-style. No gathering. They drop from monsters and chests (`drop`), come back from salvaging gear (`salvage`), and a few are sold (`vendor`). GRADES are the heart of the gating. Every shard has a grade 1-4 (`grades`), the grade a drop gets is set by the AREA level and the grade salvage gives is set by the ITEM level of what you break. A shard's grade caps the roll: when a shard rerolls or adds affixes, the affix tiers are rolled at rollIlvl = min(item.ilvl, grade.rollCap). So a Rough (grade 1) Churn Shard on an ilvl-40 rare rolls as if the item were ilvl 14: tiers 1-2 only. To get tier-5 affixes you need an ilvl-32+ ITEM and a Keen (grade 3) or better shard, and both only exist past area level 28. That is the owner's rule in one line: low-level materials only touch low-tier affixes. NOT SET FOR LIFE: (1) the item's own ilvl is a hard ceiling nothing raises — there is no "raise item level" shard on purpose; (2) shard grades are a second ceiling; (3) the affix level requirement (affixes.json) means a low-level character cannot even WEAR a tier-5 roll; (4) crafting at ilvl 12 produces an item a level-20 zone out-drops by itself (see docs/ITEMS.md worked example); (5) converting grades up costs 5:1 plus gold and never skips a grade; (6) salvage of a unique/legendary gives shards, never the item back. VENDOR: only the cheap shaping shards (Glimmer, Tangle, Bloom, Blank, Whet) are sold, at grade 1 only; grade 2+ must drop or be salvaged. Every price is gold at grade 1; `vendorGradeMult` says what a higher grade would cost if a future act sells it. Buying is capped at `vendorDailyCap` per shard per game day so gold cannot replace drops. CONVERT (at the crafter): 5 shards of one id and grade -> 1 of the same id one grade up, for `convertGoldPerGrade` gold; 1 -> 3 one grade down, free. 20 Dust of a grade -> 1 Glimmer of that grade. DUST: `shard_dust` is the small change. Salvage always gives some; 20 dust of a grade make one Glimmer of that grade at the crafter, and that is all it does. It carries a grade like a shard.

shards.name: Glimmer Shard
shards.does: Turns a NORMAL item into a MAGIC item with 1-2 affixes.

shards.name: Tangle Shard
shards.does: Rerolls every affix on a MAGIC item (new affixes, new tiers, new values; 1-2 affixes again).

shards.name: Bloom Shard
shards.does: Adds one affix to a MAGIC item that has only one.

shards.name: Crown Shard
shards.does: Turns a MAGIC item into a RARE: keeps its affixes and adds one more.

shards.name: Blank Shard
shards.does: Strips an item back to NORMAL (same base, same item level, quality kept). Never works on a unique or a legendary.

shards.name: Polish Shard
shards.does: Rerolls the NUMBERS of every affix on the item inside their current tiers (the affixes and tiers stay). Works on uniques and legendaries too.

shards.name: Churn Shard
shards.does: Rerolls every affix on a RARE item (3-6 new affixes at the roll level). The bread and butter of rare crafting.

shards.name: Graft Shard
shards.does: Adds one affix to a RARE item with fewer than 6.

shards.name: Pare Shard
shards.does: Removes ONE random affix from a magic or rare item.

shards.name: Wager Shard
shards.does: Turns a NORMAL item into a random rarity: magic 70%, rare 25%, unique 4.5%, legendary 0.5% (the unique must exist for that base; otherwise rare).

shards.name: Whet Shard
shards.does: Raises an item's QUALITY by 5% (weapon damage or armour / block amount), to a maximum of 20%. Quality survives every other shard.

shards.name: Anchor Shard
shards.does: Locks ONE affix you choose: the next Tangle or Churn used on this item keeps it. The lock is spent by that one reroll. The meta-crafting shard — rare, never sold.

drop._doc: per kill per player: chance (whole percent, keyframes by area level) that ONE currency item drops; then pick a shard by dropWeight among those with fromAreaLevel <= area level; the grade is the one whose [ilvlMin, ilvlMax] holds the area level (dropAreaMin lets the next grade appear a couple of levels early at `earlyGradePct`). Monster kinds multiply the chance.

salvage._doc: Break an item at the crafter (or from the bag, with a confirm). Grade = the grade whose ilvl range holds the ITEM level. Yields are [min, max] counts; `pick` lists which shards can come out and their weights — salvage can never give Anchor. A unique or legendary salvages into its listed shards plus one guaranteed Polish.
salvage.qualityBonus: each 5% quality on the salvaged item adds +1 dust

crafterNpc._doc: In town. Screens: Apply shard (drag shard onto item, shows the roll level = min(ilvl, grade cap) BEFORE you confirm, and lists which tiers are reachable), Salvage (with the yields shown), Convert, Buy. Every shard action is logged (item before/after) so a bug report can show what happened.

rules: ilvl never rises; rollIlvl = min(item.ilvl, grade.rollCap)
grade drops follow the AREA level, grade salvage follows the ITEM level; neither follows the character level
a finished item's level requirement rises with its best affix tier, so a level-6 character cannot wear a tier-4 roll (ilvlMin 23 -> level 19) even if a friend gives one
Anchor never drops below area 18 and is never sold; Graft needs area 12
vendor stock is grade 1, 10 a day, 5 shaping shards only
convert up is 5:1 with a gold fee and one grade at a time
uniques and legendaries cannot be Blanked or Crowned, only Polished (numbers) — their power stays what it dropped as
